raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "issue"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "14 invoices"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be the amount of"
  role subject "each invoice"
  role object "1.250 lei plus VAT 21%"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "collect"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "9 invoices"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@c constraint
  var ?total int
  var ?per_invoice int
  var ?collected int
  var ?outstanding int
  claim ?per_invoice equal 1250 times 121 divided_by 100
  claim ?total equal 14 times ?per_invoice
  claim ?collected equal 9 times ?per_invoice
  claim ?outstanding equal ?total minus ?collected
  task prove
  select ?outstanding
